ordered_decision_rules: missing price or failed source -> unavailable
missing or invalid calendar, identity, timezone, interval, provenance, or point-in-time evidence -> unverified_session_observation
source observation belongs to a strictly older completed session -> stale_source
future or mismatching session/interval timestamp -> unverified_session_observation
latest completed session matches but finality policy is absent or unapproved -> unverified_session_observation
all independent session and price checks pass -> verified_latest_session_close
temporal_invariants: calendar known_at <= generation cutoff within complete schedule validity
source bar label interpreted using declared timezone and timestamp semantics, never relabeled as close time
regular-session interval must match expected calendar interval
max completed close <= generation cutoff determines latest session
original freshness status and source timestamps are immutable

consumer_policy.usable_count: distinct union of current assets and independently verified latest-session assets
